{{Quote|After ''eliminating'' Techo Union Foreman ''Wat Tambor'' at the end of the ''Clone Wars''…Lord Vader undertook a Mission to Skako Minor, executed all of the ''Tambor loyalists'' and installed a new regime loyal to the ''Empire''.|[[ZED-6-7]], to [[Sabé]]|<ref name="Vader 28" />}}
After [[Mission to Mustafar|eliminating]] the [[Techno Union]] [[Foreman]] [[Wat Tambor]]<ref name="Vader 28" /> in [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] undertook a '''Mission to Skako Minor''' to [[Death|eliminate]] Tambor's [[Ruling Council (Skako Minor)|loyalists]] on the [[planet]] [[Skako Minor]]. The mission was a success and Vader killed all the loyalists, with a [[Skakoan Council|regime]] loyal to the [[Galactic Empire]] installed afterwards.<ref name="Vader 28" />
